config_yaml:
target:
    uris:
        - valkey://127.0.0.1:6379
    mode: auto
    client: valkey-go
    sentinel:
        master_name: ""
    read_from_replicas: false
    pool:
        pipeline_depth: 1
    tls:
        enabled: false
        ca_file: ""
        cert_file: ""
        key_file: ""
        server_name: ""
        insecure_skip_verify: false
run:
    duration: 10s
    concurrency: 64
    seed: 1
    op_budget: 0
    deterministic: false
    target_ops_per_sec: 0
    coordinated_omission: false
    loop: closed
    load_profile:
        kind: fixed
        workers: 0
        start_workers: 0
        end_workers: 0
        ramp_over: ""
        steps: []
        base_workers: 0
        peak_workers: 0
        spike_at: ""
        spike_for: ""
        min_workers: 0
        max_workers: 0
        period: ""
    sweep:
        kind: none
        values: []
        pause: 0s
dataset:
    key_count: 100000
    key_prefix: 'plgv:'
    key_distribution: uniform
    zipf_s: 0
    value_size: 256
    collection_size: 100
    hash_tag_groups: 0
    hash_fields: 8
    bitmap_bits: 10000
    stream_length: 20
    ttl:
        mode: none
        seconds: 300
        min_seconds: 60
        max_seconds: 3600
        fraction: 1
    preload: true
workload:
    mix:
        - op: GET
          weight: 80
        - op: SET
          weight: 20
    pubsub:
        subscribers: 0
        channels: 16
        sharded: false
    allow_dangerous: false
server_metrics:
    enabled: false
    interval: 1s
    slowlog: true
    slowlog_entries: 128
    latency: true
keyspace_analysis:
    enabled: false
    samples: 10000
    top: 10
    match: ""
record:
    path: /home/user/plgv-data/recordings/rec-20261106T170642Z-23e39c.plgvrec.zst
    compression: zstd
    max_mb: 0
    backpressure: fail
    outcomes: true
    checksums: false
    data_fingerprint: true
output:
    sample_interval: 1s
    summary_file: ""
label: recorded
